topic: एक दिन आदत छूट जाए, तो क्या सारी progress शून्य हो जाती है?
working_title_hi: एक दिन आदत छूट जाए, तो क्या सारी progress शून्य हो जाती है?

scientific_evidence: A real-world habit-formation study reported that missing one opportunity did not materially affect the process.
Habit automaticity develops through repetition in a stable context and varies across people and behaviours.
scientific_limitations: The single-missed-opportunity finding does not establish that frequent lapses or long breaks have no effect.
A 2024 systematic review notes substantial variability and methodological limitations in the underlying evidence.
practical_behavioral_strategy: Resume at the next feasible cue and adjust the plan to lower friction.
not_claimed: No promise of automatic habit formation, treatment, or clinical outcome is made.

sources.use: Primary study for the single missed opportunity finding
Systematic review and meta-analysis for variability and evidence limitations
